name: ral-f1-candidate-ranking
primary: Mean selected-sequence regret on the common candidates over all bank states: true planner cost of each model's lowest-predicted-cost sequence minus the lowest true cost in the bank, wam_branch minus wam_demo, paired over training runs with a Student-t 95% interval. Hypothesis: lower regret with branches.
secondary: common-candidate Spearman correlation between predicted and true cost
common-candidate overlap of predicted and true top-32 elites
optimism of the selected sequence: true minus predicted cost
the same metrics on each model's own restart-planner candidates, plus the true-cost gain of the selected sequence over the policy prior
all of the above separately for demonstration and noisy-expert states
status: Registered before any checkpoint was scored on this bank. Uses frozen ral-evidence-v2 checkpoints; no training or tuning.
